title: The write step rewrites links and kept pages the route stage renamed, writes brief phones as tel: links and heading emphasis as real tags, never keeps refused demo words silently, hides empty video play buttons and self-link more buttons, sends kept links to hidden pages to a living page, and hides hard coded article blocks on created pages; the site check never reads green on nothing checked and compares printed alts with what step 8 saw
steps: S1: From the checkout run the run command (write step and site check test files, one at a time).
S2: Read the result of each named test.
expect: AD, AE, P: a link written to an address the route stage renamed is rewritten to the new address, kept pages under a renamed parent are listed and measured at their live address, and an article page is renamed by its article alias.
AQ, AN: a brief phone number in a created page's words is a tel: link, and a created legal page prints through the kit's plain article layout.
J, AG: a site check group that checked nothing is not applicable with its reason or unmeasured, never green; a hide the contract has no slot for is blamed on step 0.

AH, AP, K, AL, AB: list-rows reads only the row's own block; a maps search map button is not refused; a slot printed as an image alt or title counts as printed; a rerun with the same files keeps removed slots; the look guard lets words replace social icons for a person with no account.

N, AS: heading emphasis is stored as real tags where the demo value is HTML, found in the whole stored value when rows removed in the same write moved the indexed heading, and words not found once block step 9; a refused text slot never keeps demo words in silence.
Y: the site check's alt-matches-picture group blocks an alt that does not describe the picture step 8 placed, and is not applicable when no picture was written.

AR, AF, AM: a kit that names its play buttons gets one hide rule in its head block; each kept page hides only the more buttons that lead to itself, written after the renames; a link its row keeps to a hidden page goes to a living page, by a menu item id that a later rename (AD) leaves alone.

AT: a kit that names blocks its article file prints hard coded (a share bar) gets one hide rule in its head block, scoped to the menu items that open the pages the write step created, so other articles keep the block.

selectors.headRules: hideEmptyVideoButtons, hideSelfLinkButtons, hideHiddenPageLinks and hideOnCreatedPages in apps/tracy-web/src/write-step/

evidence: 06/11/2026, cards AD AE P AQ AN J AG AH AP K AL AB N AS Y AR AF AM AT from step 9 and step 11 bench runs on a sealed JA Boxing quickstart, merged into PR 415.
fence: Write step and site check on invented fixtures with fake door and page readers. Not exercised: a real site write, a real browser page read, the Postgres-backed bench.

tests: a url menu item and a link in a slot that name a moved address are written to the new one and read back
every way of writing a brief phone is wrapped once; other numbers and existing tel: links are left alone
a group that checked 0 with no reason is unmeasured, counted, and the verdict is not red
a group that checked 0 and says why is not applicable, printed with its reason, and keeps the verdict green
a slot whose demo value is HTML gets real tags; the ACM slot keeps its codes
the three rungs, each tried once: plain words, then hide, then a failed line naming the demo text
an alt that describes its picture agrees; one that names another scene blocks on that slot, blamed on step 6
a kit that names its play buttons gets one hide rule in its head block, beside the brand block, read back there
the stage writes the rules after the renames, at the address the page answers now, and reads them back
a relinked address survives the rename of the living page it names: the renamed-link stage leaves it alone
rows removed in the same write move the heading: the words are found in the whole stored value and converted
a heading the emphasis stage could not convert blocks the write step with the reason; a converted one does not (card N)
through the entry point: the created privacy page gets the rule at the item that opens it, with no guard finding
